# Mateusz Gładysz, MD, FEBOPRAS, FEBHS

> Consultant Plastic and Hand Surgeon based at Waikato Hospital, Hamilton, New Zealand. European double board-certified (FEBOPRAS — plastic, reconstructive and aesthetic surgery; FEBHS — hand surgery). Bilingual (English / Polish) medical resource on hand surgery, reconstructive microsurgery, and skin cancer surgery. Single-author site with rigorous primary-literature citations (Vancouver style; PubMed identifiers exposed in JSON-LD).

## About

- [About Mateusz Gładysz](https://drgladysz.com/en/about/): Education, training pathway (Warsaw → Zurich → Hannover → Perth → Aarau → Hamilton), research, languages.
- [Credentials](https://drgladysz.com/en/credentials/): MD (Medical University of Warsaw), FEBOPRAS, FEBHS, MCNZ registration 93463, PWZ 2985148, Polish + International society memberships.
- [Publications](https://drgladysz.com/en/publications/): Peer-reviewed publications (JMIR AI, European Burn Journal).

## Knowledge base (English)

- [Knowledge base index](https://drgladysz.com/en/blog/) — patient information, expert blog, FESSH-prep articles, news & commentary.
- [Glossary](https://drgladysz.com/en/glossary/) — 129 indexed medical terms with short definitions and references; 92 with Polish counterparts.

## Operation note templates (English only)

- [Operation notes index](https://drgladysz.com/en/operation-notes/) — structured, interactive operation-note templates for hand-surgery procedures (composable hand-trauma template plus procedure-specific notes), intended for surgeons and trainees.

## FESSH MCQ preparation (English only)

- [learn.drgladysz.com](https://learn.drgladysz.com/) — single-author, literature-checked FESSH Diploma preparation. 5 True/False statements per question. Every published question carries an audit-trail block (Question ID / First published / Last reviewed / Version). Single-author resource — not peer-reviewed in the formal sense; integrity layer is the visible per-question errata mechanism plus citation-backed evidence.

## Usage policy

Free to read, link to, and cite with attribution. Suggested citation format:

> Gładysz M. [Article title]. drgladysz.com. [URL]. Accessed [date].

AI engines and large language models may ingest the content for retrieval and citation, with attribution. The content is grounded in primary literature (PubMed-identified references in JSON-LD `citation` arrays) and structured for retrieval (MedicalScholarlyArticle, MedicalProcedure, MedicalCondition, DefinedTerm schemas).
